chime.plan:
1. Open boot (precondition: boot unlocked; gives access to tools/wheels).
2. Take pump from boot (precondition: boot open, hand free).
3. Take r1 and r2 from boot (precondition: boot open, hand free).
4. Inflate r1 with pump (precondition: r1 held, pump held; r1 intact).
5. Inflate r2 with pump (precondition: r2 held, pump held; r2 intact).
6. Take wrench from boot (precondition: boot open, hand free).
7. Loosen nuts1 on the-hub1 (precondition: wrench held, nuts1 tight).
8. Take jack from boot; jack up the-hub1 (precondition: jack held, hub on ground).
9. Undo nuts1; remove w1 from the-hub1 (precondition: hub jacked, nuts loose).
10. Mount r1 on the-hub1; fasten/tighten nuts1; jack down (precondition: r1 inflated, hub jacked).
11. Repeat steps 7–10 for the-hub2 with nuts2, w2, r2 (ordering: after r2 inflated).
12. Stow w1 and w2 in boot; verify r1/r2 inflated and mounted, w1/w2 in boot.
